applies_why: The judge text decides whether cited verses count as unanswered witnesses under K-G4.
quote: RESULT: UNCURED; WHY: no PRESSED line, no RETRACTED line, and no statement that names a pressing round and quotes it, for D2 vs C3
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
room: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted: (1) an answered statement removes the verse from the count without any pressed-line quote; (2) a malformed retraction must still name and quote the pressing round before it can cure.
why: The judge text treats the line as UNCURED for lack of a pressed-line quote even though it acknowledges the witnesses were named and answered, so it fails K-G4's rule that an answered verse is not counted.
